meshy_tasks.prompt: Meadowhart, the gentle meadow deer creature for a stylised 3D creature-collecting action RPG, the SAME character, same body shape, same pose, same face and same proportions as the grey-background 3D model render, with the same palette: warm tawny-brown fur, cream chest, belly, muzzle and leg undersides, white fawn spots on the flanks and rump, brown antlers, dark hooves, big dark friendly eyes. LEAF MANTLE: a much RICHER layered leaf mantle: overlapping rows of broad leaves in olive green (#7a8a3a), fresh leaf green (#8fa64a) and a few warm ochre-gold autumn leaves (#c89a3c), with visible midribs and soft shading between the layers, draped over both shoulders and the withers and continuing in tapering overlapping rows along the top of the back to mid-back, plus a few leaves around the base of the neck. Same leaf palette as the reference, just fuller and more layered. Stylised hand-painted creature-game look with clean readable colour blocks, Palworld / Pokemon Legends style 3D render, not photoreal. Full body in frame, plain flat light grey background, even studio lighting, no scenery, no text. No red, pink, maroon or oxblood anywhere (the inner ears are warm beige). Single creature only.
